name: workflow
description: Portable workflow modes and Git utilities for controlled investigation, discussion, reporting, verified self-reviewed documentation (user-manual), and ticket-scoped worktrees with complete handoff briefings.

interface.shortDescription: Workflow modes: readonly, discuss, ask, summary, user-manual, and ticket-scoped worktrees.
interface.longDescription: Workflow-control skills that constrain how the agent works: read-only investigation, discussion mode without changes, direct question answering, work summaries, verified self-reviewed user manuals, external repo cloning for inspection, detached-HEAD checkouts, and ticket-scoped git worktrees.
defaultPrompt: Enter discussion mode and investigate this issue without changing anything
Summarize the work completed in this session
Write a user manual for this feature aimed at non-engineers
capabilities: Constrain the agent to read-only or discussion-only behavior
Produce verified, self-reviewed documentation and work summaries
Manage ticket-scoped git worktrees and external repo clones
